atoms.text: It's time for dinner! Let's cook pasta with tomato sauce.

atoms.sound: We need pasta, tomatoes, ketchup, onions, salt and pepper

instruction.text: Ordne jedem deutschen Wort die passende englische Übersetzung zu.
Welche Utensilien brauchen wir zum Kochen? Tippe die richtigen Übersetzungen an.
Lies dir das Rezept durch und entscheide im Anschluss, ob die Aussagen richtig oder falsch sind.

atoms.text: First, fill a pot with water, add some salt and boil the water on the cooker. When the water boils, put the pasta into the pot. Now, you can start cutting the vegetables. Start with the onions and go on with the tomatoes. Next, fry the onions in a pan with oil.
atoms.sound: ssml: First, fill a pot with water, add some salt and boil the water on the cooker. <break time='1000ms'/> When the water boils, put the pasta into the pot. <break time='1000ms'/> Now, you can start cutting the vegetables.<break time='1000ms'/> Start with the onions and go on with the tomatoes. <break time='1000ms'/> Next, fry the onions in a pan with oil.

atoms.a: You put the pasta into boiling water.
The onions boil in a pot with water.

instruction.text: Lies dir das Rezept durch und entscheide im Anschluss, ob die Aussagen richtig oder falsch sind.

atoms.text: Add the tomatoes to the onions and fry again. Now you can add ketchup and water to make a sauce. Mix it. Add some salt and pepper to the sauce. When the pasta is ready, you can put it on a plate. Finally, put the tomato sauce on the pasta.

atoms.a: Mix ketchup and water to make a sauce.
You put salt and pepper into the sauce.
You put the sauce on the plate first.

instruction.text:
Lass uns nun als Letztes den Tisch decken. Ziehe folgendes Geschirr auf den Tisch:
fork, spoon, knife, plate, glass.
